## Background

Game developed on GDev and can be found [here](https://m4meh.itch.io/caknak-cyberquest){target="_blank"}. **Game** and **charts** fully designed by me, while all art assets are all credited in Main Menu.

This game was made back in **May 2025** and it was done as part of my final semester for my [Industry experience studio project](https://handbook.monash.edu/2025/units/FIT5120) unit.

## Aim
The target audience for this games were Malaysian teens, to educate them on cybersecurity in a fun way, hence the gamification of data story-telling. Very much inspired by [The Pudding](https://pudding.cool/){target="_blank"}.

It covers three common cybersecurity traps most people fall into:

* Spam
* Fraud
* Intrusion
